scope: All seven original Core/book/access envelopes and20 questions reviewed. This is source triage, not full procedure/case acceptance. No new rule selected.

perIdentityFindings.arcane-aegis: The rank4 threshold must use generating native rank, not paid RP or class level. Rank7 ward source and rank3 Arch Dispel are different from the dispel target ceiling; rank3 being capable of checking rank7 does not make its generated rank7. Globe outside-origin exception is absent here and must not be imported silently. Resolve lower-rank beneficial applications, prior expressions, ordinary summoned body actions and mandatory terminal returns independently.
perIdentityFindings.spell-turning: Preserve one actual d4+2 capacity roll. Direct-sole-recipient restrictions are NEW limitations of the broad source, not an existing grant from LR-G14. A reflection is not a new cast; keep original owner/DC/cost/root/Null. State interception versus successful return, an unwilling or invalid original caster, blocked line, which charge spends, and mutually exclusive arbitration across Mirror/Soul Mirror/Turning. Missing reflection scope prevents acceptance now.
perIdentityFindings.dimensional-lock: The source blocks teleportation AND planar travel. Whole body/cargo at origin and destination, a physical planar portal crossing, mundane carrying and magic nonteleport movement need separate operations. No visual path interception for an instantaneous outside-to-outside teleport. Accepted named Banishment terminal-return exceptions are exact exceptions; pending Planar6 and Time5 do not acquire them automatically.
perIdentityFindings.resonance-fortress: Rank7 allies permission and rank9 caster-only impenetrability are distinct profiles, not unionable benefits. Current class access grants only rank7/17RP. Rank9/26RP remains unassigned even if authored. ALL magic includes a classification decision for class/item magic; a spell-caster exemption cannot be laundered through an allied carrier. Hemisphere radius/height/base/floor collision, actual body fit, anchored removal and allegiance-change timing require complete new rules.
perIdentityFindings.faction-aegis: Need a concrete faction, actual permission and source-qualified negative standing. Unknown reputation is not negative. Immunity to effects includes more than damage but cannot recursively erase every historical environmental consequence. Declare bounded causal attribution, current versus historical expressions, real changed-standing timing, and avoid leaking a private score.
perIdentityFindings.corruption-immunity: Retain 86,400 real seconds. The eligible canonical Corruption classification must come from an actual effect, not evil/necrotic/disease flavor. No automatic Exposure track reset, Null Veil purge or Oracle intrinsic Curse removal. Separate preventing a new application from suppression or cure of an existing record; blocked opportunities do not queue or refresh clocks.
perIdentityFindings.summon-living-armor: Core Self and printed self-or-ally conflict requires explicit delivery choice. +4AC is an additive modifier whose family/proficiency/armor compatibility must be settled, not a replacement base formula. Magical suit does not itself grant creature classification, Conjuration HP bonuses or free autonomous actions. Define body fit, weight, actual equipment identity, suppression/meld/removal, and preservation of real underlying gear.

requiredCoverage: At least14 current fully sourced operational cases plus separately declared rank9 unassigned-profile analysis/adverse branches. Do not simulate a fictional class-acquired rank9 Fortress.

preservedQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Book/catalog spells level4-or-lower; Core Tier4-or-lower, Action120InstantaneousVSF.
preservedQuestions.options: A: actual generating spell rank0..4 and an explicitly finite recipient ward. B: class level, resource paid, material tier or unlimited permanent immunity.
preservedQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend A using the already accepted native rank interpretation, preserving competing words. Choose duration/concentration, exact recipient and consent/save, benefit/hostile inclusion and self-cast behavior. Actual authorized rank changes count; discounts do not. Globe uses outside-origin geometry; Arcane Aegis prints no outside-origin restriction, so transferring that exception would be a new weakening to justify.

preservedQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Immunity to spells is broader than damage resistance but does not print a general antimagic field.
preservedQuestions.options: A: whole protected-recipient application prevention with explicit treatment of prior effects. B: damage-only resistance or erasure of every magical source.
preservedQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Select exact new spell applications, beneficial healing/buffs, area components, ongoing spell expression, spell-created body arrival and existing attached effects. State whether existing spells are suppressed while protected or remain operative; immunity is not automatically a cure. Real bodies previously created outside, their nonspell actions and item/class engines keep actual classifications. Multi-recipient casts resolve other targets normally. Paid costs and displaced concentration are never retroactively refunded.

preservedQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Removal, overlapping wards and source-specific terminal returns can meet a low-rank immunity.
preservedQuestions.options: A: explicit self-protection/anchor and coexistence with current named exceptions. B: an immune ward that silently blocks every possible removal or all mandatory return forever.
preservedQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: State whether a lower-rank actual dispel aimed at the ward anchor is blocked and how eligible higher-rank/nonspell removal works. Wizard Arch Dispel is explicitly rank3 even when its target check reaches higher ranks. Actual Banishment BAN-CLOSE-03 and its two named AC5 extensions retain terminal-return protections; do not generalize those to other travel. Recast family, suppression, expiry and retained histories need exact endpoints, without secret rank diagnostics.

preservedQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Reflect1d4+2spells back at caster; Action120InstantaneousVSF.
preservedQuestions.options: A: a finite recipient ward rolling capacity once at successful establishment. B: arbitrary repeated rerolls, no duration or one charge per damage die/recipient.
preservedQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend A with explicit duration/concentration, recipient/consent, initial capacity draw and presentation. Define whether interception is automatic first eligible or a chosen timing window before outcomes. Preserve1d4+2 and consume one capacity per actual eligible source interception. Same-family replacement must not bank/carry unspent charges unless expressly chosen. The private capacity draw grants no sixth Fate presentation.

preservedQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Printed spells is broad; Spell Mirror/Soul Mirror LR-G14 is explicitly scoped to those two sources.
preservedQuestions.options: A: explicitly extend a selected finite direct-sole-recipient return model to this spell. B: broader area/multitarget/ongoing reflection with complete new ownership and geometry rules.
preservedQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend A only as a declared new scope choice; do not claim LR-G14 already grants it. Decide rank ceiling if any, beneficial spells, Touch/willing/type eligibility, class-tagged wizard spells versus ordinary-only, area and channel exclusions. Preserve source-dependent cost/owner/DC/concentration rather than create a free cast or learned spell. An original caster who is dead, unavailable, wrong type or unwilling may be an illegal return recipient; choose the exact paid outcome, not automatic free cancellation.

preservedQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Returns can encounter other mirrors, caster wards, opaque barriers and existing spell root flags.
preservedQuestions.options: A: complete one-return causal protocol with explicit cross-source arbitration. B: repeated reflection loops, rewritten original dealer or two copies of one effect.
preservedQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: State actual before-attack/save window, line/barrier and distance rules, which ward spends on attempted illegal/blocked return, and whether original recipient then resolves. Name exact interaction with Spell Mirror/Soul Mirror and other distinct reflection features; a new single-return flag must not silently rewrite their accepted permissions. Recheck genuine new-target protection while retaining original source root provenance/Null and payment. Define end at capacity0, suppression/expiry and no queued interception.

preservedQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: ALL teleportation AND planar travel prevented in an area; Action120InstantaneousVSF. Earlier source question deferred the whole spell until verified push.
preservedQuestions.options: A: now discuss one complete post-push spatial prevention model preserving both clauses. B: approve only teleport prevention or invent new plane topology.
preservedQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Verified032bc7e permits this conference, not adoption. Choose supported/free volume, full dimensions, fixed/moving origin, finite duration/concentration and recipient/body-volume boundary. The field is not a physical wall by inference. Existing actual plane identities and travel classifications suffice; no master cosmology, native-origin label, campaign epoch or local-to-Ethereal map is supplied.

preservedQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Teleportation may start/end outside or inside; physical planar portals and forced carriage use different predicates.
preservedQuestions.options: A: exact origin/destination whole-body prevention and actual cross-plane crossing admission. B: vaguely block any path that visually crosses the field.
preservedQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Distinguish same-plane instant displacement, origin outside/destination outside, partial boundary overlap, ordinary movement/carrying, physical planar aperture crossing and nonteleport magical movement. Faction Portal is teleport; Alignment Portal is physical planar travel, so both clauses matter. Specify beings versus cargo/objects, known preflight failures versus paid hidden failures, and a crossing already atomically committed. No body/cargo bisection, hidden-place diagnostic, generic Speed0 or new damage root.

preservedQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Accepted Banishment terminal closure has a named prevention exception; other travel packets are pending.
preservedQuestions.options: A: preserve existing exact terminal exceptions and decide new spell-specific conflicts explicitly. B: strand ended exile cells or borrow terminal exceptions for every pending travel spell.
preservedQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Preserve ordinary Banishment and the expressly extended Banish Elemental/Elemental Banishment closure while retaining physical collision/support rules. Pending Blink/Etherealness/Veiled Chest return models stay unapproved; source conference comparisons cannot grant them bypass. Choose overlapping Lock behavior, local suppression, genuine dispel and expiry with no replay or traveler duplication. No area reapplication refunds casts or resets travel clocks.

preservedQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Rank7 blocks magic not cast by you OR ALLIES; rank9 is IMPENETRABLE and blocks magic not cast by YOU. Current actual classAccess grants rank7 only.
preservedQuestions.options: A: retain separate complete source profiles and explicitly mark rank9 unassigned unless a real acquisition route exists. B: union both benefits/costs or create generic paid upcasting.
preservedQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend A. Preserve both placements/Core entries and17/26RP metadata. Rank9 is not acquired simply because its source exists; no current rank7 caster obtains its physical impenetrability for17RP. Director may author a clearly unassigned rank9 profile for later routing, but no class progression changes are inferred. Resolve Instantaneous versus ongoing dome duration/concentration separately for each retained profile.

preservedQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Dome geometry and blocking ALL MAGIC need more than a rank-capped damage ward.
preservedQuestions.options: A: complete local dome boundary/admission rule with actual half-space geometry and origin attribution. B: mix Globe recipient protection with Wall of Force collision and unrestricted ally firing.
preservedQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Select radius/height/floor/base closure/support, placement around occupied bodies, physical passage and sight/LoE. Distinguish spells crossing boundary, magic born inside, existing attached effects, item/class magic, summoned bodies and their actual nonspell actions. Spell-cast exceptions inspect the real generating caster, not allied carrier/controller/visual origin. Do not silently exclude nonspell magic from ALL MAGIC or suppress an entire mundane attack because one rider is magical. Rank9 impenetrability needs exact finite physical exceptions and ending if authored.

preservedQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Allies and caster exceptions change over time and can conflict with authority removal.
preservedQuestions.options: A: exact source-qualified ally predicate, sampling time and full removal/maintenance semantics. B: friendly appearance or public faction standing grants a loophole for enemy magic.
preservedQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Define actual ally relationship, whose allies, reassessment versus initial designation and whether an unknowing caster learns hidden relations. Specify direct spell origin versus lasting summoned source, return/remote cast origin and stolen magic items. Resolve casts launched before allegiance change and simultaneous effects in stable order. State how the dome can be dispelled/suppressed under its own filter, original caster death, overlapping domes and clock expiry. No implicit immunity to all removal or indefinite fortress resource.

preservedQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Target immune to EFFECTS from creatures with negative faction reputation; Action120InstantaneousVSF.
preservedQuestions.options: A: one explicitly chosen canonical faction with real invocation permission and actual standing-3,-2,-1. B: guessed hostility, evil alignment, affiliation or absent reputation counts negative.
preservedQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend A using current Faction Seal/Ward permission and standing records only within their exact roles. Choose recipient, consent/save, duration/concentration and actual sampling event. Missing standing remains unknown and supplies no matching predicate. Which faction matters must be explicit; casting does not grant membership, credentials or alter any standing. No source-specific immunity is inferred for every faction at once.

preservedQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Effects includes more than incoming damage; origin may be a creature, construct, field, projectile or environmental consequence.
preservedQuestions.options: A: exact direct causal prevention with named source-owner/controller rules. B: damage-only resistance, global noninteraction or erasure of all consequences caused by a disliked person.
preservedQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Define attacks, non-damage conditions, forced movement, healing, ongoing areas, created companions/devices, mundane objects and triggered transfers. Use actual source attribution; an allied intermediary cannot automatically launder a hostile origin, and a remote creator is not always the actual current dealer. Distinguish current effects from completed historical damage/body/equipment changes and independently physical falling/collapse. State where the finite causal chain ends rather than grant immunity to all environment.

preservedQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Reputation changes, suppressed effects and multiple wards can change protection mid-sequence.
preservedQuestions.options: A: explicit per-application current predicate and retained source clocks. B: retroactive outcome changes or private-reputation diagnosis on every prevention.
preservedQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Choose exact assessment time and handling of already-established effects, owner/controller changes, per-target roots, standing becoming negative/neutral and recast/overlap. No old damage is rewound or expired condition replayed. Define ward removal and source-independent mandatory endings. Publicly observable relief is ordinary evidence; no creature ID, hidden faction score or inventory report is granted. Current rule engines and timing remain authoritative.

preservedQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Immunity to CORRUPTION EFFECTS for24hours; Action120VSF, no concentration marker.
preservedQuestions.options: A: full86,400-second recipient immunity to actual canonically tagged mechanical effects. B: an alignment/ancestry judgment, shortened generic1minute ward or automatic cleansing.
preservedQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend A with explicit recipient/consent and any newly proposed concentration clearly labeled. Reuse canonical Corruption predicate from actual Ward/Purge; theme, necrotic, disease, faction and intrinsic Oracle Curse do not qualify merely by name. Distinguish new condition applications, source-tagged damage and separate effect components. Preserve the full24hours through rest and initiative; source-specific actual exceptions need explicit evidence.

preservedQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Existing Corruption records and numeric Exposure tracks are not all removable effects.
preservedQuestions.options: A: prevent new qualifying applications and explicitly suppress applicable ongoing expression while retaining records/clocks. B: delete underlying causes, refund old exposure or cure every permanent trait.
preservedQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Choose the exact effect of immunity on existing records and continuing consequences. Corruption/Unity Exposure numeric tracks need their own actual source; no track reset or immunity follows without an explicit scope extension. Null Veil is separately governed and has exact named removal routes; this spell is no new purge route by harmful association. Intrinsic anatomy/class engines and completed physiological changes persist unless an exact source says otherwise. Define whether actual scheduled opportunities are consumed while blocked and what resumes without replay.

preservedQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Protection itself can expire, be dispelled or be locally suppressed before its24-hour deadline.
preservedQuestions.options: A: preserve the same finite source with exact present-versus-operative rules and same-family replacement. B: reset immunity time on leaving suppression or retroactively apply prevented corruption.
preservedQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Specify suppression on a real whole body, local protection, source ending and whether a genuine cure while suppressed can remove a retained record. Initial prevention creates no record to resume. Existing effects may resume only while still present/unexpired and within their own source. Rest, death/resurrection, form changes and new casting do not mint new duration or erase history; any death-ending choice must be explicit.

preservedQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: A magical SUIT grants+4AC to SELF OR ALLY; CoreSelf,Action,concentration60VSF.
preservedQuestions.options: A: source-faithful self/ally option with explicitly chosen ally delivery range. B: erase ally option or turn the suit into an independent creature.
preservedQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Choose and label the range conflict, actual willing eligible body, placement/fit, donning time and any real empty armor slot. Define material/weight/Load, size, anatomy, grippers and handling needed, coexistence with existing armor/shield/unarmored defenses and whether it grants armor proficiency. Living adds no independent mind, creatureHP/command/attacks by itself. Preserve+4 as the exact granted modifier subject to actual same-family AC rules; do not replace it with an invented baseAC or add multiple suits.

preservedQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: A finite conjured suit can be suppressed, melded, damaged, removed or outlive a wearer’s active body.
preservedQuestions.options: A: complete equipment manifestation/history and finite ending rules. B: permanent salvage, duplicated former armor or universal immunity to item damage.
preservedQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Choose whether a real separately damageable suit or nonseparable magical armor expression, and provide actualHP/AC/targeting only if the former is adopted. Define suppression versus full ending, original concentration/expiry, resizing/form/meld and incompatibility with external gear. No Conjuration creatureHP bonus applies merely because the source is Conjuration; target classification controls. Ending retains all real underlying equipment, current damage and spent resources, without sellable/harvestable free duplicate matter.

futureCaseRequirements: After actual decisions, at least two complete current scenarios per identity plus each genuinely different source profile and branch. Explicitly unassigned rank9 Fortress cannot be a fictional real class cast.
Actual class/level/repertoire/RP/components, original caster and recipient bodies/gear, source clocks, ordinary turn/Ready schedules and full spell/damage provenance.
Arcane Aegis beneficial and hostile immunity, rank4/rank5, actual area components, prior effects, permitted removal and surviving physical nonspell acts.

Spell Turning actual1d4+2 capacity, first actual interception, legal and illegal willing/type returns, full cost and remaining charges, mirrors/one-root arbitration, source Null and suppression/expiry.
Dimensional Lock inside/outside/straddling full bodies and cargo, real teleport versus physical portal crossing, hidden paid failures, existing named terminal return exceptions and no replay.
Resonance Fortress distinct rank7/allies and unassignedrank9/caster-only profiles, all-magic source attribution, true body dome geometry, physical crossing and removal.
Faction Aegis actual faction permission, real negative/unknown/changed standing, effects beyond damage, prior expressions, independent physical consequence and no hidden score leak.
Corruption immunity full86400-second deadline, source-tagged components versus exposure/Null/Oracle Curse, genuine cure versus temporary suppression, restored source without retroactive applications.
Living Armor self/ally range conflict, real compatible body, armor and shield stacking/proficiency/weight, actual item targeting if admitted, form meld/removal and underlying gear preserved.
No scripted encounter substitutes for gameplay execution. All conditional missing profiles, prerequisites and synthetic arithmetic remain explicit.
